    sertion saw an empty jar
    test result: FAILED. 11 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 2.31s

• The test sleeps for 200 ms and then reads the session cookie, so it races the refresh request that sets it. On a busy machine the refresh takes longer than the sleep and the jar is still empty when
  the assertion runs. The session helper already has wait_for_cookie, which polls the jar until the cookie is there or a timeout passes, so the test can wait for the cookie itself instead of a fixed
  time. I'll switch the test to it and keep the 5 second timeout                                                                        kly instead of hanging the whole suite on a missing cookie.
